name: bo6sp
title: Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 (campaign, sp24)
note: The campaign has its own exe (sp24-cod.exe, PE timestamp 1781887896) and zone names it shares with cod24 (global, code_post_gfx...), hence a profile of its own beside bo6. Its zone loader is Modern Warfare III's (global stream state, no load context: ParseFastFile, Load_Stream, push/pop, advance read instruction for instruction like mwiii's) with the multiplayer's pointers (bit 61 inline, keys filed and looked up, assets by name hash: stream.keyed_refs). Addresses mapped from mwiii's by aligning the two exes' functions.
install_note: Plain Steam files: sp24\*.ff (400, 222 of them _tr) with 12 .fp patches, streamed data in sp24\*.xsub. Container: Games/IW/Container25.cpp (shared with Black Ops 7) (IWffa100 0x19).
rva_note: file_read = ReadXFile(dst, n) 0x26aa7d0. Load_Stream(flag, dst, n) 0x26f55d0 (mwiii 0x3bbcc80): flag 0 returns at once; block 11 memsets, any other reads; the position advances. load_string 0x26f56e0 the text a byte at a time (a name-only asset reference's name too, then hashed by 0x1fa9f30); load_string_ptr 0x26f5630 the same, then interned (AllocateUniqueString 0x4c53cd0). push(block) 0x26bd310 / pop 0x26bd250 keep a 16-byte stack in the stream globals; advance(mask) 0x26afc10. alloc 0x2581a20(alignment + 1): advance(alignment), the stream position returned.

asset_dispatch.note: ParseFastFile 0x26f5300 (mwiii 0x3bbcb00): file_read of the 0x20-byte XAssetList; push(15); Load_ScriptStringList 0x25b7850(0, list); pop; push(15); the array aligned (advance 7) and read (count x 16, inline); per asset Load_XAsset(0, &list[i]) 0x25e14c0; pop. The switch 0x25e1520 is a cmp chain on the type id: 307 of 315 types.

stream.machinery_note: the stream init's block table copy (AssignFastFileMemoryPointers 0x26bd0a0) and the function object assignment (0x2581a40) DB_InitLoadStreams 0x26f4ed0 calls; the Load_Stream functor class (vtable 0x9ec5498: invoke, copy, move, destroy); 0x25819e0, Load_Stream's function object called by value
stream.null_page_note: engine lookups the dump leaves empty return null and the loader reads through it: a zero page reads as an empty result
stream.stream_objects_note: the Load_Stream function object (vtable slot 0x9eb6ce8, functor 0x9eb6cf0) DB_InitLoadStreams sets: the readers' own read for flag 1
stream.keyed_refs_note: as bo6's: inline when bit 61 is set, filed under value & 0x1fff... unless bit 62 (ResolveStreamPositionEx 0x26f4dd0, a hash map at the zone memory's 0x10cd0), a back reference by that key otherwise (ResolveStreamPosition 0x26f4f50); bit 63 clear brackets the read by 0x26b09b0 / 0x26b0710 (the asset offset frames, no read). Asset pointers: -1 / 0x7fff... inline, 0x3fff... name only, else the referenced asset's name hash (LinkGenericXAssetEx 0x26b5f00)
stream.temp_strings_note: a name-only asset reference reads its name into a stack temporary (load_string 0x26f56e0 on a local set to the stream position, then hashed): READSTR
stream.stream_object_calls_note: 0x25819e0(that, bool flag, dst, n): the Load_Stream function object called with its arguments by value (a 0x42d0-byte struct, 0x25d367f)

stream_init_call.note: DB_InitLoadStreams(zone) 0x26f4ed0: Load_Stream installed in the function object (0x2581a40), the 16 blocks {base, size} from the zone memory's 0x10bc8 into the stream globals (0x26bd0a0), the zone and its memory kept in 0xbf93620 / 0xbf93618

memory_objects.note: the rewind table ResolveStreamPosition (0x26f4f50) looks keys up in: hashedRefs at 0x38, bucket count at 0x40; empty

transcriber_budget_note: a reader whose symbolic run passes 200 000 instructions is refused (the table generation once took over 10 minutes on a handful of them)
